def detect(t, fps):
    # Wing threat = quick bilateral wing raise -> unusually wide silhouette
    # held briefly while near opponent, not fast running.
    # Symmetric pair test via max_* / pair columns.
    n = len(t['max_minor_ratio'])
    fps = float(fps)

    # max_minor_ratio: median ~1.04, p75 ~1.11, p95 ~1.38. Bilateral wings
    # add ~25-30% width, so ON=1.25 is rare/strong, OFF=1.12 just above
    # typical variation to hold the posture while wings stay out.
    w_raw = t['max_minor_ratio']
    k_fast = max(3, int(round(0.1 * fps)))  # ~0.1 s smoothing, preserves quick raise
    w = smooth(w_raw, k_fast)
    wide = hysteresis(w, on=1.25, off=1.12)
    wide = wide & np.isfinite(w)

    # --- "quickly raises": >=12% width gain within last 0.3 s ---
    # Expected bilateral raise ~30% in ~0.1-0.15 s; 0.12 in 0.3 s passes
    # true raises but rejects slow drift / baseline differences.
    K = max(2, int(round(0.3 * fps)))  # 0.3 s lookback
    past_min = np.full(n, np.nan)
    for k in range(1, K + 1):
        r = np.roll(w, k)
        r[:k] = np.nan
        # NaN-aware min: fmin ignores NaN
        past_min = r if k == 1 else np.fmin(past_min, r)
    rise = w - past_min
    quick_here = np.isfinite(rise) & (rise >= 0.12)

    # keep whole wide bout if onset was quick (not just first 0.3 s)
    filt = np.zeros(n, dtype=bool)
    if np.any(wide):
        iw = wide.astype(int)
        d = np.diff(iw)
        starts = list(np.where(d == 1)[0] + 1)
        ends = list(np.where(d == -1)[0] + 1)
        if wide[0]:
            starts = [0] + starts
        if wide[-1]:
            ends = ends + [n]
        for s, e in zip(starts, ends):
            if np.any(quick_here[s:e]):
                filt[s:e] = True

    # --- context: near opponent, not merged, not fast run ---
    # dist_bl median ~1.34, p95 ~2.5: <3.0 BL keeps all plausible threats,
    # vetoes far-apart false widenings. gap>1 vetoes merged/touching masks
    # where minor_len is unreliable. both_present required.

    dist_bl = t['dist_bl']
    gap = t['gap']
    prox = (
        both
        & np.isfinite(dist_bl) & (dist_bl < 3.0)
        & np.isfinite(gap) & (gap > 1)
    )

    # Stillness: reject fast runs/flights that distort shape.

    msr = t['max_speed_raw']
    still_ok = ~np.isfinite(msr) | (msr < 80.0)

    cand = filt & prox & still_ok

    # Bridge flicker (translucent wings intermittently in mask) and drop

    out = bouts_clean(cand, fps, min_s=0.15, max_gap_s=0.2)
    return out.astype(bool)

    med_b = np.nanmedian(b_maj)

    # Not rapidly separating: closing > -0.5 BL/s rejects retreats/escapes
    # while allowing contact lunges where dist cannot fall further. NaN -> False.
    not_leaving = np.isfinite(closing) & (closing > -0.5 * bl)

    burst = both & close & aligned & (strict | loose) & not_leaving

    # Snap is a few samples: keep short bouts, don't smooth away.
    # min 0.06 s (~2 frames at 30 fps), bridge 0.12 s gaps.
    mask = bouts_clean(burst, fps, min_s=0.06, max_gap_s=0.12)
    mask = np.asarray(mask, dtype=bool)

    # Long fast-close runs are chases/wrestling, not a snap: drop bouts >0.5 s.
    max_len = int(round(0.5 * fps))
    if max_len < 1:
        max_len = 1
    if np.any(mask):
        m = mask.astype(np.int8)
        d = np.diff(m)
        starts = list(np.where(d == 1)[0] + 1)
        ends = list(np.where(d == -1)[0] + 1)
        if m[0] == 1:
            starts = [0] + starts
        if m[-1] == 1:
            ends = ends + [N]
        for s, e in zip(starts, ends):
            if (e - s) > max_len:
                mask[s:e] = False
    return mask

def detect(t, fps):
    # Lunge = one fly rears (foreshortened body) then snaps fast toward the other
    # from close range. Pair-level: test with max/min (symmetric), allow NaN explicitly.
    n = len(t["dist"])
    def G(k):
        v = t.get(k, None)
        if v is None:
            return np.full(n, np.nan, dtype=float)
        return np.asarray(v, dtype=float)

    both = G("both_present") == 1
    dist_bl = G("dist_bl")
    gap = G("gap")
    axis = G("min_axis_align")
    peak = G("peak_toward_raw")  # max toward-speed in next 0.3 s: marks whole burst incl. pre-peak rear
    mx_spd = G("max_speed_raw")  # label-free fast speed, valid while touching
    mn_spd = G("min_speed_raw")  # quieter fly: separates lunge (one moves) from chase (both run)
    mx_spd_s = G("max_speed_s")  # 0.5 s smoothed speed: sustained running vs brief snap
    a_maj = G("a_major_len")
    b_maj = G("b_major_len")

    # body length scale from this video (~25-30 px): all speeds relative to it
    all_maj = np.concatenate([a_maj[np.isfinite(a_maj)], b_maj[np.isfinite(b_maj)]])
    bl = float(np.median(all_maj)) if all_maj.size > 0 else 27.0  # px per body length
    if not np.isfinite(bl) or bl < 10 or bl > 50:
        bl = 27.0

    # Close range: within ~1.5 BL centroid distance or masks within ~8 px (~0.3 BL).
    # Lunge is launched only when essentially touching; median dist is 1.34 BL / gap 18 px.
    close = both & ((np.isfinite(dist_bl) & (dist_bl <= 1.5)) | (np.isfinite(gap) & (gap <= 8)))

    # Pointing: one fly's body axis within ~0.6 rad (~34 deg) of direction to other.
    # Median min_axis_align ~0.41 rad; random ~0.78 rad.
    aligned = np.isfinite(axis) & (axis <= 0.6)

    # Burst: snap is >~1 BL/s; strong lunge >~1.75 BL/s (~47 px/s, top ~10% of toward bursts).
    # Weak path >~1.0 BL/s (~27 px/s) only if rearing dip seen nearby.
    thr_strong = 1.75 * bl
    thr_weak = 1.0 * bl
    burst_strong = np.isfinite(peak) & (peak >= thr_strong)
    burst_weak = np.isfinite(peak) & (peak >= thr_weak)

    # Attacker must actually dart: max raw speed >= ~0.9 BL/s.
    attacker = np.isfinite(mx_spd) & (mx_spd >= 0.9 * bl)

    # Snap is brief: slow (0.5 s) speed stays low (<~1.2 BL/s); sustained chase stays high.
    # NaN (vel hidden near touch/area jump) is allowed because raw columns stay valid there.
    slow_ok = (~np.isfinite(mx_spd_s)) | (mx_spd_s <= 1.2 * bl)

    # Asymmetry: quieter fly not also dashing (<~1.5 BL/s); rejects mutual chase.
    quiet = (~np.isfinite(mn_spd)) | (mn_spd <= 1.5 * bl)

    # Rearing shortens top-view body length: major_len < ~88% of that fly's own median.
    # p25 major_len ~27 px ~ median, so 0.88*median (~24 px) is rare foreshortening, not normal.
    med_a = float(np.median(a_maj[np.isfinite(a_maj)])) if np.any(np.isfinite(a_maj)) else bl
    med_b = float(np.median(b_maj[np.isfinite(b_maj)])) if np.any(np.isfinite(b_maj)) else bl
    dip_a = np.isfinite(a_maj) & np.isfinite(np.array(med_a)) & (a_maj <= 0.88 * med_a)
    dip_b = np.isfinite(b_maj) & np.isfinite(np.array(med_b)) & (b_maj <= 0.88 * med_b)
    dip = dip_a | dip_b
    # rear precedes snap peak by up to 0.3 s, so dilate dip by +-0.3 s (total 0.6 s window)
    W = int(round(0.3 * float(fps)))
    if W < 1:
        W = 1
    k = 2 * W + 1
    if k < 3:
        k = 3
    dip_near = smooth(dip.astype(float), k) > 0  # any dip within +-0.3 s

    cand_strong = close & burst_strong & aligned & attacker & slow_ok & quiet
    cand_weak = close & burst_weak & aligned & attacker & slow_ok & quiet & dip_near
    cand = cand_strong | cand_weak

    # Snap is only a few samples: keep >=~0.09 s (>=2-3 samples at 30 Hz), fill <=0.12 s gaps.
    mask = bouts_clean(cand, fps, min_s=0.09, max_gap_s=0.12)

    # Drop long bouts (>0.6 s): those are chases/charges, not a snap-down.
    out = mask.astype(bool).copy()
    if np.any(out):
        idx = np.where(out)[0]
        # find run boundaries without exceptions
        breaks = np.where(np.diff(idx) > 1)[0]
        starts = np.concatenate([[idx[0]], idx[breaks + 1]])
        ends = np.concatenate([idx[breaks], [idx[-1]]])
        max_len = int(round(0.6 * float(fps))) + 1
        for s, e in zip(starts, ends):
            if (e - s + 1) > max_len:
                out[s:e + 1] = False
    return out

def detect(t, fps):
    # Lunge = rear-up (shortened top-view body) + fast snap down onto other fly.
    # Body length ~27 px, so 1 body-length/s ~27 px/s. Walking median max_speed_raw
    # ~7.6 px/s, p75 ~35 px/s; lunge covers ~0.5-1 BL in ~0.1 s => 50-100 px/s.
    n = t["dist"].shape[0]

    # Typical body length per fly for rear-shortening test (robust to video scale).
    med_a = np.nanmedian(t["a_major_len"])
    if not np.isfinite(med_a):
        med_a = 27.0  # fallback body length px
    med_b = np.nanmedian(t["b_major_len"])
    if not np.isfinite(med_b):
        med_b = 27.0

    # Rear-up: top-view major axis shortens well beyond stride wobble
    # (IQR only ~1 px / ~4%); 10% shortening = clear rear, still above p5 dips.
    rear_a = np.isfinite(t["a_major_len"]) & (t["a_major_len"] < 0.90 * med_a)
    rear_b = np.isfinite(t["b_major_len"]) & (t["b_major_len"] < 0.90 * med_b)
    rear = rear_a | rear_b  # symmetric pair test

    # Close range: launched within ~2 BL and masks nearly touching.
    # dist_bl median 1.34, gap median 17.9 px; this keeps closest ~half of frames.
    close = (
        np.isfinite(t["dist_bl"]) & np.isfinite(t["gap"])
        & (t["dist_bl"] <= 2.0) & (t["gap"] <= 15.0)
    )

    # Attacker axis points at target (no heading sign needed).
    # min_axis_align median 0.41 rad; 0.7 rad (~40 deg) keeps aligned ~2/3.
    aligned = np.isfinite(t["min_axis_align"]) & (t["min_axis_align"] < 0.7)

    # Fast snap toward other fly. Use peak_toward_raw (max over next 0.3 s) so the
    # whole burst including pre-peak wind-up is marked; raw column stays valid
    # while flies touch (vel_ok hides standard columns there).
    # ON 45 px/s ~1.6 BL/s (between p75 26 and p95 117, rare burst);
    # OFF 25 px/s ~1 BL/s (above walking, keeps burst shoulders).
    peak = t["peak_toward_raw"]
    peak_f = np.where(np.isfinite(peak), peak, -1e9)  # NaN explicitly not burst
    burst = hysteresis(peak_f, 45.0, 25.0)

    # Partner relatively still: rejects joint sprints (chase). min_speed_raw
    # p75 7.3, p95 46.8; 35 px/s allows normal walking, rejects both-fast.
    quiet = np.isfinite(t["min_speed_raw"]) & (t["min_speed_raw"] <= 35.0)

    both = t["both_present"] == 1
    candidate = burst & close & aligned & both & quiet

    # Require rear-up nearby (+-0.25 s) to reject chases/runs without rearing.
    k_rear = int(round(0.5 * fps))
    if k_rear < 3:
        k_rear = 3
    rear_near = smooth(rear.astype(float), k_rear) > 0  # any rear in window
    gated = candidate & rear_near

    # Include the rear frames themselves: rear + close + aligned adjacent to snap.
    k_dil = int(round(0.4 * fps))  # +-0.2 s around snap
    if k_dil < 3:
        k_dil = 3
    dil_gated = smooth(gated.astype(float), k_dil) > 0
    include_rear = rear & close & aligned & both & dil_gated
    pre = gated | include_rear

    # Snap is few samples: fill tiny gaps, drop single-frame noise.
    cleaned = bouts_clean(pre, fps, min_s=0.12, max_gap_s=0.15)

    # Lunge total (rear+snap via 0.3 s peak lookahead) < ~0.6 s; drop long
    # sustained toward-running (courtship chase) that passed gates.
    max_len = int(round(0.6 * fps))
    if np.any(cleaned):
        idx = np.where(cleaned)[0]
        brk = np.where(np.diff(idx) > 1)[0]
        starts = np.concatenate(([idx[0]], idx[brk + 1]))
        ends = np.concatenate((idx[brk], [idx[-1]]))
        out = cleaned.copy()
        for s, e in zip(starts, ends):
            if (e - s + 1) > max_len:
                out[s:e + 1] = False
        cleaned = out
    return cleaned.astype(bool)

def detect(t, fps):
    # Lunge = one fly rears up (foreshortened body seen from above) and snaps
    # down on the other: requires CLOSE + ALIGNED + FAST closing burst.
    # Pair-level OR over a/b for symmetry. All speeds in px/s, body ~27px,
    # so 1 body-length/s ~ 27 px/s. Durations use fps.
    n = t["dist"].shape[0]
    both = t["both_present"] == 1

    # --- typical body length per fly for relative rear threshold ---
    med_a = np.nanmedian(t["a_major_len"])
    med_b = np.nanmedian(t["b_major_len"])
    # fallback ~27px body length if median not finite
    if not np.isfinite(med_a):
        med_a = 27.0
    if not np.isfinite(med_b):
        med_b = 27.0

    # --- rearing: apparent major_len shortened (hind-leg rear, top view) ---
    # smooth over 0.1s to reject single-sample glitches but keep ~0.1-0.2s dip
    k3 = max(1, int(round(0.1 * fps)))
    sm_a = smooth(t["a_major_len"], k3)
    sm_b = smooth(t["b_major_len"], k3)
    # <0.9*own median ~ <24-25px vs typical 27px; p25/median=0.98, p5/median~0.75
    rear_a = np.isfinite(sm_a) & (sm_a < 0.90 * med_a)
    rear_b = np.isfinite(sm_b) & (sm_b < 0.90 * med_b)

    # --- alignment needs no heading sign; 0.7 rad ~40deg, median min_align ~0.41 ---
    align_a = np.isfinite(t["a_axis_align"]) & (t["a_axis_align"] < 0.7)
    align_b = np.isfinite(t["b_axis_align"]) & (t["b_axis_align"] < 0.7)
    posture = (rear_a & align_a) | (rear_b & align_b)  # symmetric OR
    pair_align = np.isfinite(t["min_axis_align"]) & (t["min_axis_align"] < 0.6)

    # --- proximity: lunge only at close range ---
    # dist_bl median 1.34, gap median 17.9px; lunge ~within reach
    close = both & ((np.isfinite(t["dist_bl"]) & (t["dist_bl"] < 1.5)) | (np.isfinite(t["gap"]) & (t["gap"] <= 8.0)))
    # very close / touching for snap without clear length dip (masks may merge)
    very_close = both & ((np.isfinite(t["gap"]) & (t["gap"] <= 2.0)) | (np.isfinite(t["dist_bl"]) & (t["dist_bl"] < 1.0)))

    # --- fast snap burst: use *_raw (valid while touching, swap-robust) ---
    # max_toward_raw p75~9.6 p95~60; closing p75~2.3 p95~35; 30-45px/s ~1.1-1.7 BL/s
    peak = t["peak_toward_raw"]  # max of toward over next 0.3s, marks whole burst incl. onset
    mtow = t["max_toward_speed_raw"]
    clos = t["closing_speed_raw"]
    mspd = t["max_speed_raw"]
    burst_mod = np.isfinite(peak) & (peak >= 30.0)  # moderate burst incl. pre-peak samples
    burst_strong = (np.isfinite(mtow) & (mtow >= 45.0)) | (np.isfinite(clos) & (clos >= 35.0))
    fast = np.isfinite(mspd) & (mspd >= 30.0)  # must actually move ~1 BL/s, not posture noise

    cand1 = close & burst_mod & fast & posture  # rear evidence + burst + close
    cand2 = very_close & burst_strong & fast & pair_align  # strong snap at touch w/o length dip
    raw = cand1 | cand2

    # --- snap is a few samples: drop 1-sample spikes, join rear+snap gap ---
    out = bouts_clean(raw, fps, min_s=0.08, max_gap_s=0.15)
    # bouts_clean may return int; force bool, ensure length n, NaN-safe
    out = np.asarray(out, dtype=bool)
    if out.shape[0] != n:
        tmp = np.zeros(n, dtype=bool)
        m = min(n, out.shape[0])
        tmp[:m] = out[:m]
        out = tmp
    # require both present in output sample (no detection on missing fly)
    out = out & both
    return out
